milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to navigate near the target and visually observe it. The birch trees are placed at two locations relative to spawn: (~5, ~0, ~3) and (~-4, ~0, ~2). We target the closer tree at (-4, 1, 2) — the middle of its trunk — with max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 so the player must be within 16 blocks and looking toward the birch log. This correctly models 'player can see the birch log'.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted furnace ends up in the player's inventory. The player must chop birch logs (iron axe provided), craft birch planks in the 2x2 inventory grid, craft a crafting table from 4 planks, place it, then use the 3x3 grid with the 8 cobblestone (provided in starting inventory) to craft a furnace. The furnace item is not in the starting inventory, so its presence confirms successful crafting.
